title: STICKS KEEP THEIR ANGLE AND FULL DIAGONAL SPEED
why: Separate axis deadzones bent aim and walking toward straight directions and shortened diagonal travel.
now: Both sticks use a circular deadzone with full diagonal travel. Deadzone and sensitivity settings stay available.
